Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns of the as-prepared PdAu bimetallic catalysts are shown in Figure 1 (a). Two peaks at 38.14° and 44.50° can be observed in the XRD pattern of the Pd0.50Au0.50/PDA-rGO catalyst. The 2θ positions of these two peaks are slightly larger than the reference diffraction peaks of the Au(111) (38.08°) and Au(200) (44.26°), respectively, according to the international center for diffraction data (ICDD: 00-004-0784).
